name: rapid

rig.pose_convention: degrees; upper bones world-angle (0 = down); forearm/shin relative to parent; spine 0 = up; shlx/shly, shrx/shry, hplx/hply and hprx/hpry move each shoulder and hip pivot per keyframe, relative to the rig-level pivot base; wp swings the weapon about the grip at (wpx,wpy); wspin rolls it about its own long axis; wlen scales the blade along its length and rot spins the whole figure about its hips (both Rig Forge extensions, not part of the documented schema); weapon.shapes holds independent sub-shapes, weapon.points repeats the first for v1 readers

battle_semantics: Battle properties live per can_hit FX layer, not per action. Attack props (Explode, Scatter, Pierce, Slash) stack and are visual-only; defence props are mutually exclusive per layer and only "deflect" has an engine implementation.
fx_semantics: fx_layers follow fx-authoring.md. Burst anchors (point, r_hand) are fixed-offset approximations from the character root — no live joint tracking.
activation_trigger_semantics: Layers activate via trig / trig_ref / trig_delay_ms chains; cycle fields reference layers as "action_name:LayerID".
authoring_note: Authored in Rig Forge. Draw-order/visibility layers are an authoring construct and are not exported; in-betweens are baked into keyframes because the loader plays keyframes as authored with no interpolation.
